title: Broad-universe + always-attempt daily ingestion for fundamental/alt data streams
root_causes: All fundamental/alt ingestion consumed the narrow data_universe (~58 = watchlist + pilots) instead of the broad ~1229 universe feed.
companyfacts refresh was env-gated off (KOVA_REFRESH_COMPANYFACTS default False) AND stale_days=None meant already-cached CIK files were treated as permanently fresh -> cache frozen at 2026-06-04.

DEEPER BUG: sec_companyfacts_backfill._ticker_to_cik_map read DATA_DIR/'sec_company_tickers.json' (data/ root) which no longer exists after the file was relocated to data/reference/; the map silently resolved to EMPTY, so every ticker failed CIK resolution and companyfacts would have refreshed nothing even with the flag on. Same broken path in form4_backfill and sec_filing_backfill (these had a narrower fallback, so they kept working but on a reduced map).

quant/run.py: Compute broad_ingest_universe (broad feed union trade universe, ~1229) once early, with safe fallback to data_universe.
Rank broad universe by 30d dollar volume (warehouse) into options_ingest_tickers so the free options source attempts the most-liquid names.
Wire fetch_broad_universe_earnings(tickers=broad_ingest_universe) after the core earnings snapshot (additive merge, batched/rate-limited).
FINRA: candidate universe unioned with broad_ingest_universe (cadence stays bi-weekly/regulatory).
fixes.quant/kova_data_sidecar.py: persist_kova_data_snapshot gains companyfacts_stale_days, threaded into backfill args.
fixes.quant/fetch_broad_earnings_snapshot.py: fetch_broad_universe_earnings gains optional tickers= (uses caller universe, else PEAD ~500).

verification.broad_earnings_merge_probe: earnings snapshot 58 -> 62 tickers; non-watchlist KEYS/ZBRA/AOS/PNR landed with real next_earnings_date + eps_estimate.
verification.companyfacts_cik_resolution: ticker->CIK map 0 -> 10341 after path fix; AAPL/MSFT/NVDA resolved; backfill wrote 492 rows, 0 errors; 3 CIK cache files re-fetched (were frozen 2026-06-04).
verification.options_dollar_volume_ranking: 1333 ranked, 1229 in broad universe; top5 = MU,NVDA,MSFT,AMD,AAPL (most liquid first).

physical_limits_documented.options_onclickmedia: free source cannot cover the full universe; capped at the ~250 most-liquid by dollar volume, still attempted every run.
physical_limits_documented.finra_short_interest: FINRA publishes bi-weekly for all exchange-listed securities; coverage widened to broad universe but cadence stays bi-weekly (regulatory, not daily) -- attempted every run, new cycle pulled when published.

next_run_expectation: Full broad coverage materializes on the next production run.py; companyfacts cache rolls fresh on a 2-day stale throttle; earnings/kova/finra cover ~1229 names.
